arxiv-2003-10047.title: Predicting the evolution Of SARS-Covid-2 in Portugal using an adapted SIR Model previously used in South Korea for the MERS outbreak
arxiv-2003-10047.creator: Pedro Teles
arxiv-2003-10047.description: Abstract Since original reports in Wuhan, China, the new coronavirus covid-19 has spread very quickly worldwide, leading the World Health Organization (WHO) to declare a state of pandemic. Moreover, as of the 13th of March 2020, the WHO has announced that the European continent is now the main centre of the pandemic.

arxiv-2012-02701.title: Constant round distributed domination on graph classes with bounded expansion
arxiv-2012-02701.creator: Simeon Kublenz, Sebastian Siebertz, Alexandre Vigny
arxiv-2012-02701.description: Abstract We show that the dominating set problem admits a constant factor approximation in a constant number of rounds in the LOCAL model of distributed computing on graph classes with bounded expansion . This generalizes a result of Czygrinow et al. for graphs with excluded topological minors.

arxiv-2105-00122.title: On the trifference problem for linear codes
arxiv-2105-00122.creator: Cosmin Pohoata, Dmitriy Zakharov
arxiv-2105-00122.description: Abstract We prove that perfect 3 3 -hash linear codes in 𝔽 3 n \mathbb{F}_{3}^{n} must have dimension at most ( 1 4 − ϵ ) ​ n \left(\frac{1}{4}-\epsilon\right)n for some absolute constant ϵ > 0 \epsilon>0 . 1 Introduction A code of length n over an alphabet of size k\geq 3 is a subset \mathcal{F} of \left\{0,1,\ldots,k-1\right\}^{n} .

arxiv-2110-03389.title: Beam Search with Bidirectional Strategies for Neural Response Generation
arxiv-2110-03389.creator: Pierre Colombo, Chouchang (Jack) Yang, Giovanna Varni, Chloé Clavel
arxiv-2110-03389.description: Abstract Sequence-to-sequence neural networks have been widely used in language-based applications as they have flexible capabilities to learn various language models. However, when seeking for the optimal language response through trained neural networks, current existing approaches such as beam-search decoder strategies are still not able reaching to promising performances.

arxiv-2112-14332.title: Adaptive Client Sampling in Federated Learning via Online Learning with Bandit Feedback
arxiv-2112-14332.creator: Boxin Zhao boxinz@uchicago.edu, Lingxiao Wang lw324@njit.edu, Ziqi Liu ziqiliu@antfin.com, Chaochao Chen zjuccc@zju.edu.cn, Mladen Kolar mkolar@marshall.usc.edu
arxiv-2112-14332.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Boxin Zhao boxinz@uchicago.edu, Lingxiao Wang lw324@njit.edu, Ziqi Liu ziqiliu@antfin.com, Chaochao Chen zjuccc@zju.edu.cn, Mladen Kolar mkolar@marshall.usc.edu. † † Correspondence: Mladen Kolar (mkolar@marshall.usc.edu) and Jun Zhou (jun.zhoujun@antfin.com). Due to the high cost of communication, federated learning (FL) systems need to sample a subset of clients that are involved in each round of training. As a result, client sampling plays an important role in FL systems as it affects the convergence rate of optimization algorithms used to train machine learning models.

arxiv-2210-11491.title: Binary neutron star merger simulations with neutrino transport and turbulent viscosity: impact of different schemes and grid resolution 2022 Binary neutron star merger simulations with neutrino transport and turbulent viscosity: impact of different schemes and grid resolution – References
arxiv-2210-11491.creator: Francesco Zappa, Sebastiano Bernuzzi, David Radice, Albino Perego
arxiv-2210-11491.description: Abstract We present a systematic numerical relativity study of the impact of different treatment of microphysics and grid resolution in binary neutron star mergers. We consider series of simulations at multiple resolutions comparing hydrodynamics, neutrino leakage scheme, leakage augmented with the M0 scheme and the more consistent M1 transport scheme.

arxiv-2303-06713.title: Uniqueness for the Dafermos regularization viscous wave fan profiles for Riemann solutions of scalar hyperbolic conservation laws
arxiv-2303-06713.creator: Christos Sourdis
arxiv-2303-06713.description: Abstract . We prove the uniqueness of solutions to the Dafermos regularization viscous wave fan profiles for Riemann solutions of scalar hyperbolic conservation laws. We emphasize that our results are not restricted to the small self-similar viscosity regime. We rely on suitable adaptations of Serrin’s sweeping principle and the sliding method from the qualitative theory of semilinear elliptic PDEs.

arxiv-2402-11575.title: CaloGraph: Graph-based diffusion model for fast shower generation in calorimeters with irregular geometry
arxiv-2402-11575.creator: Dmitrii Kobylianskii, Nathalie Soybelman, Etienne Dreyer, Eilam Gross
arxiv-2402-11575.description: Abstract Denoising diffusion models have gained prominence in various generative tasks, prompting their exploration for the generation of calorimeter responses. Given the computational challenges posed by detector simulations in high-energy physics experiments, the necessity to explore new machine-learning-based approaches is evident. This study introduces a novel graph-based diffusion model designed specifically for rapid calorimeter simulations.

arxiv-2404-00351.title: Rethinking Attention-Based Multiple Instance Learning for Whole-Slide Pathological Image Classification: An Instance Attribute Viewpoint
arxiv-2404-00351.creator: Linghan Cai, Shenjin Huang, Ye Zhang, Jinpeng Lu, Yongbing Zhang
arxiv-2404-00351.description: Abstract Multiple instance learning (MIL) is a robust paradigm for whole-slide pathological image (WSI) analysis, processing gigapixel-resolution images with slide-level labels. As pioneering efforts, attention-based MIL (ABMIL) and its variants are increasingly becoming popular due to the characteristics of simultaneously handling clinical diagnosis and tumor localization.

arxiv-2404-17500.title: A note on the rational non-integrability of the N N -center problem for almost all degrees of the singularities
arxiv-2404-17500.creator: Eddaly Guerra-Velasco 1,2 , Boris Percino-Figueroa 2 , Russell-Aarón Quiñones-Estrella 2
arxiv-2404-17500.description: Abstract . In this article, we show that the N N -center problem with rational weak and moderate forces is not rationally integrable for all but a finite number of values α ∈ ( 0 , 2 ) ∩ ℚ \alpha\in(0,2)\cap\mathbb{Q} , where α \alpha is the order of the singularities.

arxiv-2503-12394.title: Multivariate disaggregation modeling of air pollutants: a case-study of PM2.5, PM10 and ozone prediction in Portugal and Italy
arxiv-2503-12394.creator: Fernando Rodriguez Avellaneda
arxiv-2503-12394.description: Abstract Air pollution remains a critical environmental and public health challenge, demanding high-resolution spatial data to better understand its spatial distribution and impacts. This study addresses the challenges of conducting multivariate spatial analysis of air pollutants observed at aggregated levels, particularly when the goal is to model the underlying continuous processes and perform spatial predictions at varying resolutions.

arxiv-2511-12629.title: Bandit Learning in Housing Markets
arxiv-2511-12629.creator: Shiyun Lin
arxiv-2511-12629.description: Abstract The housing market, also known as one-sided matching market, is a classic exchange economy model where each agent on the demand side initially owns an indivisible good (a house) and has a personal preference over all goods. The goal is to find a core-stable allocation that exhausts all mutually beneficial exchanges among subgroups of agents.

europmc-pmc3539359.creator: Seisenberger S, Peat JR, Hore TA, Santos F, Dean W, Reik W.
europmc-pmc3539359.description: In mammalian development, epigenetic modifications, including DNA methylation patterns, play a crucial role in defining cell fate but also represent epigenetic barriers that restrict developmental potential. At two points in the life cycle, DNA methylation marks are reprogrammed

plos-pone-0358979.description: First burials give insights into mortuary rites at Göbeklitepe, Early Neolithic Türkiye

pmc-10605035.title: Language Outcomes of Children Born Very Preterm in Relation to Early Maternal Depression and Anxiety
pmc-10605035.creator: Sisan Cuervo, Nancy Creaghead, Jennifer Vannest, Lisa Hunter, Chiara Ionio, Mekibib Altaye, Nehal A. Parikh
pmc-10605035.description: Unaddressed maternal psychological distress within the first year postpartum is known to have numerous negative consequences on the child’s developmental outcomes, including language acquisition. This study examined the relationship between early maternal psychosocial factors and the language outcomes of children born very preterm (VPT; ≤32 weeks gestational age).

pmc-10646867.title: Aortic sodium [18F]fluoride uptake following endovascular aneurysm repair
pmc-10646867.creator: Samuel Debono, Jennifer Nash, Alexander J Fletcher, Maaz Syed, Edwin J R van Beek, Michelle Claire Williams, Orwa Falah, Andrew Tambyraja, Marc R Dweck, David E Newby, Rachael O Forsythe
pmc-10646867.description: ObjectiveIn patients with abdominal aortic aneurysms, sodium [18F]fluoride positron emission tomography identifies aortic microcalcification and disease activity. Increased uptake is associated with aneurysm expansion and adverse clinical events. The effect of endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) on aortic disease activity and sodium [18F]fluoride uptake is unknown. This study aimed to compare aortic sodium [18F]fluoride uptake before and after treatment with EVAR.

pmc-10670589.title: Correlation Analysis on Anatomical Variants of Accessory Foramina in the Sphenoid Bone for Oncological Surgery
pmc-10670589.creator: Andrea Palamenghi, Michaela Cellina, Maurizio Cè, Annalisa Cappella, Chiarella Sforza, Daniele Gibelli, Shinji Miwa
pmc-10670589.description: Simple SummaryAnatomical variants are traits that differ between individuals. The sphenoid bone has numerous variant features, such as foramina and canals, that may be involved in surgical procedures. This study on CT-scan images describes the foramen meningo-orbitale, the foramen of Vesalius, the canaliculus innominatus and the palatovaginal canal and their relationships.

pmc-11434199.title: Bioactive Properties of Enzymatic Gelatin Hydrolysates Based on In Silico, In Vitro, and In Vivo Studies
pmc-11434199.creator: Fenny Crista A Panjaitan, Sin-Ting Shie, Sung Hoon Park, Tesalonika Sevi, Wen-Ling Ko, Rotimi E Aluko, Yu-Wei Chang, Jérôme Leprince, Luca D D’Andrea
pmc-11434199.description: This current study aims to analyze the potential bioactivities possessed by the enzymatic hydrolysates of commercial bovine, porcine, and tilapia gelatins using bioinformatics in combination with in vitro and in vivo studies. The hydrolysate with superior inhibition of angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) activity was used to treat the D-galactose (DG)-induced amnesic mice.

pmc-11597865.title: First Detection of West Nile Virus by Nasopharyngeal Swab, Followed by Phylogenetic Analysis
pmc-11597865.creator: Carlo Zuddas, Sergio Piras, Stefano Cappai, Federica Loi, Giulia Murgia, Giantonella Puggioni, Giovanni Savini, Federica Monaco, Andrea Polci, Fabrizia Valleriani, Giorgia Amatori, Valentina Curini, Maurilia Marcacci, Germano Orrù, Antonio Ledda, Elena Poma, Riccardo Cappai, Ferdinando Coghe, Yuying
pmc-11597865.description: West Nile Virus, an arthropod-borne RNA virus, may result in severe neurological disease. West Nile neuroinvasive disease is characterized by meningitis, encephalitis, and possible acute flaccid paralysis. Here, we report a case of neuroinvasive WNV in a 65-year-old woman hospitalized for hyperpyrexia, chills, intense asthenia, and continuous vomiting.

pmc-12610945.title: Prematurely Aged Human Microglia Exhibit Impaired Stress Response and Defective Nucleocytoplasmic Shuttling of ALS Associated FUS
pmc-12610945.creator: Christiane Hartmann, Christina Haß, Muriel Knobloch, Israel Barrantes, Laura Fumagalli, Jessie Premereur, Franz Markert, Maite Peters, Georgia Koromila, Alexander Hartmann, Kathrin Jäger, Jette Abel, Renzo Mancuso, Alexander Storch, Michael Walter, Georg Fuellen, Andreas Hermann
pmc-12610945.description: Microglia, the brain's resident immune cells, are crucial for maintaining healthy brain homeostasis. However, as the brain ages, microglia can shift from a neuroprotective to a neurotoxic phenotype, contributing to chronic inflammation and promoting neurodegenerative processes. Despite the importance of understanding microglial aging, there are currently few human in vitro models to study these processes.

pmc-13413842.title: A Review of Non-Laser and Laser Machining for Through-Glass via Fabrication
pmc-13413842.creator: Yong Zhang, Keke Zhang, Yapeng Xu, Wenjun Tong, Junfeng Wang, Wuyi Ming
pmc-13413842.description: As semiconductor packaging technology evolves from two-dimensional to three-dimensional integration, the through-glass via (TGV) technique, as a core interconnect method in advanced packaging, is emerging as a strong candidate to replace through-silicon vias (TSVs) and plated through-holes (PTHs) in organic substrates.

pmc-13452225.title: AI-based analysis of key predictors of CO2 emissions across income groups
pmc-13452225.creator: Rihab Fannouch, Saïd Tounsi

pmc-13459660.title: Direct medical costs for drug-resistant tuberculosis inpatients at the national lung hospital, Vietnam: A one-year study
pmc-13459660.creator: Do Minh Ngo, An Thi Binh Nguyen, Hanh Duc Nguyen, Hau Van Hoang
pmc-13459660.description: Drug-resistant tuberculosis remains a major global public health challenge due to its complex treatment regimens and prolonged treatment duration. Drug-resistant tuberculosis treatment requires more expensive second-line medications, intensive monitoring, and longer hospitalization, resulting in substantially higher healthcare costs. Vietnam is one of 30 countries with a high burden of tuberculosis and drug-resistant tuberculosis.

pmc-13616717.title: Pre-competitive anxiety, self-confidence, and technical-tactical performance in professional kickboxing athletes: differences between winners and defeated athletes
pmc-13616717.creator: Jonatas Deivyson Reis da Silva Duarte, Johan Robalino, Gennaro Apollaro, Cebrail Gençoğlu, Süleyman Ulupınar, Serhat Özbay, Farruh Ahmedov, Carlos Alexandre Fett
pmc-13616717.description: PurposeTo compare pre-competitive anxiety and self-confidence levels, as well as technical–tactical aspects, between winning and defeated professional kickboxers, and to examine the association of these variables with match outcomes.MethodsTwenty professional kickboxers (19 males and 1 female) participated in the study, including 10 winners and 10 defeated athletes.
